description: This file implements hardware-accelerated CRC32 computation optimized for Intel and ARM architectures, including classes and functions for CRC acceleration, SIMD usage, and CPU feature detection.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
classes.description: Class implementing hardware-accelerated CRC32 computation for Intel and ARM architectures, with methods for extending CRCs and computing zero extension constants.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreams
classes.description: Template class for handling multiple CRC streams with different algorithms and strategies, utilizing SIMD and CPU features for optimized CRC computation.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreamsBase
classes.description: Base class providing shared data and methods for multiple stream CRC acceleration.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends the CRC value by a specified number of zero bytes, using precomputed constants and multiplication for efficiency.

methods.name: ComputeZeroConstant
methods.description: Calculates a constant used to extend CRC by zeros efficiently via multiplication.

methods.name: Process64BytesCRC
methods.description: Processes 64 bytes of data to update the CRC value.

methods.name: TryNewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
methods.description: Detects CPU features and returns an instance of the optimized CRC implementation if available.

methods.name: NewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedAll
methods.description: Creates a collection of all available CRC acceleration implementations.
